title: ReuseEvent v1
description: A domain-neutral fact-axis record: one actual reuse of a pinned pattern version by one pinned run, with the outcome that run observed (ADR-0007 decision 6). Reuse events never write back into the pattern record and never overwrite it; helped/neutral/harmed aggregates are rebuildable registry-layer derivations, not pattern fields. Reuse events carry no supersedes field: facts are not revised; recording errors are handled by governance, not by a core semantic (export-receipt precedent, ADR-0004 decisions 1 and 4).

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash pinning the exact run record version.

run.description: The run that used the pattern. One-directional and hash-pinned.

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash pinning the exact pattern record version.

pattern.description: The exact pattern version snapshot that was used (plan Phase 4 task 11). One-directional and hash-pinned to a research-pattern/v1 record.

outcome.description: The outcome the run actually observed (architecture section 3.7 vocabulary, underscore style).

note.description: Optional free-text detail about how the pattern was selected, adapted, or rejected.
